newsitem.title: USA: Black Rock Golf sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Black Rock Golf sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Black Rock Golf Corp said Wednesday it expects sales for the third quarter will be significantly lower than projected, resulting in a loss for the period.
The company said lower sales were caused by late delivery of inventory of new products and lower sales from infomercials.
Deliveries of the company's new clubs, titanium drivers and the 3-wedge system, have been 30-45 days behind schedule, it said.
This delay, the company said, resulted in missing a chance to sell these clubs during the golf season in the northern U.S.
Gerald Fick, Black Rock chief financial officer, said the company projected net income of $380,000 for the third quarter.

During the quarter, infomercial sales per dollar of media costs have been significantly lower than realized in the past, the company said. This may require Black Rock to realize a one-time charge of about $100,000, the company said.
